leadText:
The Spoons of Destiny (Japanese: 運命のスプーン曲げ of Fate), known as Spoons of Fate in the Chuang Yi translation, are items in the Pokémon Adventures .

During the against the Elite Four on Cerise Island, Sabrina's created these magical spoons. The Spoons of Destiny would point out a Trainer of a similar style and personality. Using these tools, was paired with Koga, was paired with , was paired with Lt. Surge, and Sabrina herself was paired with . However, with Red absent due to injuries, Lt. Surge picked as his partner instead, even though Bill's spoon was not bent, indicating that he did not have a will to fight.

In the , Red was given a Spoon of Destiny at Mt. Silver to help locate the Gym Leaders that were trapped in the Magnet Train. This Spoon later led him and Blue to the Ilex Forest to aid in the battle against the Masked Man.

In the , Sabrina gave a Spoon of Destiny to help her pick a movie to star in at Pokéstar Studios. Despite Whitley's instance in not wanting to act, the spoon picked a Brycen-Man movie.
